g.text: Claims, advisory reservations, handoffs, plans, budgets
and unattended integration, for claude and codex side by side.
Every frame below is real command output.
One coordination server. Each agent gets its own worktree,
identity and inbox; the base checkout is never edited.
One loopback coordination server serves every project.
/home/dev/payments-api coordinates over the null forge (recorded), which opens no pull requests. Every forge e
xchange is best effort; the ledger decides ownership.
No forge for this demo: everything stays local.
ada: provider claude; identity ada; default account
ada runs on claude, in a worktree of its own.
ada: provider claude; identity ada; default account
grace: provider codex; identity grace; default account
grace runs on codex, right beside it.
Forge: open issues unavailable (no GitHub); claims on closed issues are not hidden
ada stopped 0 Check shared coordination state and await my task.
grace active 0 Check shared coordination state and await my task.
Two providers, two lanes, one shared view.
Dependencies live in one reviewed TOML file,
Chapter 2 · A work order everyone reads
Applied plan Refund rework (b2a296b4fdca): 1 dependencies recorded.
#42 waits on #41; both belong to the refunds group.
Chapter 2 · A work order everyone reads
The plan as a tree, with each issue's current owner.
An agent claims an issue and reserves what it will touch.
A second agent is told, not silently overwritten.
ada claims #41 from inside its lane.
grace asks for the same paths: a named collision.
So grace queues behind ada instead of waiting blind.
Lanes stay on their assigned branch.
The refusal says why, and what to do instead.
Chapter 4 · Guardrails in the native hooks
"permissionDecisionReason": "Agent Parley owns this worktree on 'parley/35c9925813d2d4c4/lane-1'; branch switches are blocked. C
reate or use a separate worktree for feature branches."
A branch switch inside a lane is refused before it runs.
with a summary, and only when the recipient accepts.
agent-parley issue offer 41 --to grace --summary 'Rounding traced to refund(); fix and tests remain.'
"summary": "Rounding traced to refund(); fix and tests remain.",
ada offers #41 to grace with a summary.
grace accepts; only then does ownership move.
ada releases the paths; grace's queued request is next.
#41: grace (working; event 2s ago); last progress 0s ago; no deadline
Who holds what, at a glance.
A lane can propose a change to the work order.
The operator approves it; the ledger never drifts silently.
agent-parley plan propose --base 1 --add 42:43 --reason '#42 reuses the ledger #43 introduces'
held: the applied plan defines no [revisions] envelope
ada proposes a new dependency from its lane.
No envelope: every lane proposal waits for the operator.
held: the applied plan defines no [revisions] envelope
Proposals outside the [revisions] envelope wait here.
The plan now carries the new edge.
Cap the tokens, calls and hours a whole run may spend.
Past the cap the service starts no wake, dispatch or launch.
/home/dev/payments-api enforces a run budget: calls 0 of 500, hours 0h of 8h used. Standing: within limits. Co
unts are what Parley observes, not billed spend.
Enforced for the project, observed by Parley itself.
Named issues may merge without an operator,
only after the recorded gate passes on a ready report.
/home/dev/payments-api runs `git diff --check` in the base checkout before every `participant merge`.
The gate every merge runs in the base checkout.
/home/dev/payments-api authorizes unattended integration into main for issues #41, on the terms of `participan
#41 may be integrated into main unattended.
grace commits the fix in its lane.
agent-parley report --issue 41 --state ready --summary 'Refunds clamp to whole cents' --evidence 'git diff --check: clean'
Merged parley/35c9925813d2d4c4/lane-2 into main as a merge commit, carrying 1 commits from grace. The lane and its branch are unchan
ged; retire grace separately when the lane is no longer needed.
Integrated unattended under integration.unattended: issue #41 at cda7326f7d65 into main.
Her session has exited; the merge runs behind the gate.

2026-09-27 23:06:40 report #41 grace: unattended integration integrated; claim 27a49968de054e38
